name: read / write / edit / bash
summary: A coding agent given only four tools: read a file, write a file, edit a file by string replacement, and run shell commands. Everything else (search, tests, git) goes through bash. Mario Zechner's pi agent uses exactly this set and argues it is enough because models are already trained on these tools.
how: Expose read, write, edit and bash as the only tools
Let the model use bash for search, builds, tests and git
Keep the system prompt and tool definitions small
Add more tools only when a clear need appears
facts: Under 1,000 tokens for pi's system prompt and tools (author-reported)
Small and general, but bash is broad and needs sandboxing
goodFor: Models trained on similar tool schemas
watchOut: Bash gives full shell access, so isolation matters
No structured guardrails on what commands run
